text:
alex: Quick sync — runtime observability contracts + cost insulation. I want a concrete proposal: runtime should emit a minimal envelope for billing and SLA (cost_hint, model, seq_len, tenant_hash) but only emit full spans for sampled requests or when canary=true. Does that make sense?

maria: makes sense. we need to be explicit about which fields are allowed in the cheap envelope vs full spans. cheap should never include full user prompt or PII. billing_key (hashed) + model + tokens_out + latency is enough for cost. :+1:

kevin: two quick Qs: 1) how do we derive billing_key reliably at runtime? 2) sampling: deterministic or random? we want reproducible cost accounting.

alex: answers: 1) prefer ingress to attach billing_key (resolver at API gateway) — runtime uses that if present, falls back to hashed tenant_id. 2) deterministic sampler by trace_id hash with configurable rate. ensures fixed fraction of a tenant's traffic is sampled.

sasha: runtime-side detail: if we go with deterministic sampling and pre-attached billing_key, we can keep runtime lightweight. but beware late enrichment: some requests get billing_key added downstream (eg: sidecar). fallback = emit cheap envelope and later stitch during enrichment. we should document stitch keys.

nina: can we add a tiny metric with bucketed token counts and model_name? like `runtime.cost_hint{model="x",tokens_bucket="0-64"} = 1` so billing infra can approximate cost without spans. low cardinality if we bucket.

alex: yes — cost_hint metric + envelope logs for billing is plan A. Full spans (with operator-level debug fields) only when sample_on = true or tenant has debug flag. we must ensure full spans are opt-in for enterprise tenants because of data residency.

kevin: have we decided schema for the cheap envelope? propose JSON snippet we can standardize on in the runtime SDK: ```json
{
  "billing_key": "sha256:abcd...",
  "model": "mosaic-7b",
  "tokens_out": 42,
  "latency_ms": 87,
  "sampled": false,
  "cost_bucket": "0-64"
}
```

maria: looks fine. add `sample_reason` like `det_hash` or `manual_canary` for debugging. and include `anon_tenant_hash` (low-cardinality) to allow tenant-level PSAs without exposing ID.

alex: +1. Also: redaction rules — runtime must never include prompt text in envelope; if full span is sampled, redact prompt by default unless tenant opts in. add an allowlist via customer config.

sasha: rollout idea: start with non-prod regions and 0.5% deterministic sampling for full spans, shipping cost_hint metrics everywhere immediately. then enable stitcher jobs to backfill envelopes to billing pipeline.

kevin: operational caveat: when sampling rate changes, billing interpolation becomes weird. we should keep a slowly rolling rate update, and include the `sampling_rate` field in envelopes so downstream can correct.

alex: good call. include `sampling_rate` and `sampler_version` in envelope metadata.

oncall-bot: deploy/apply completed: runtime:observability/v2 rolled to canary cluster eu-west-1 at 1759994350 — 2 pods.

nina: small UX ask: console needs a derived chart showing cost_hint vs actual billed tokens (post-stitch) so we can tune buckets. can infra own that dashboard?

maria: infra can partner. action items: 1) alex write short RFC with schema + redact rules + rollout plan. 2) kevin implement envelope payloads in runtime SDK. 3) ops: configure deterministic sampler + expose config flag. 4) infra: stitcher backfill + dashboard.

alex: I'll draft RFC today and ping reviewers. thanks all. :rocket:
